summary: The explicitly authorized eight-structure MatRIS/AQCat25 fixed prediction job 1343 was submitted on MZ73 and failed after three seconds because the shared GPU had no usable free memory; no prediction set was produced and AQCat25 was not reached.

payload.objective: Obtain the exact eight-structure MatRIS/AQCat25 fixed prediction set before deciding separately whether to submit the matching VASP static-force labels.
current_evidence: The user explicitly authorized one MZ73 fixed-structure prediction batch with the message `提交`; VASP labels, fine-tuning, ML-NEB rerun, and Dimer remained outside that authorization.
The uploaded request, authorization, preparation review, runtime scripts, eight structure files, and both checkpoint hashes passed the no-model remote preflight on MZ73.
Slurm job 1343 ran on MZ73 from 19:18:38 to 19:18:41 local time and terminated FAILED with NonZeroExitCode 1:0.
MatRIS initialized successfully, then CUDA reported only 64 KiB free on a 23.52 GiB GPU while other processes occupied memory; a further 20 MiB allocation failed.
The failure occurred during the first MatRIS prediction. AQCat25 was not executed and `predictions.json` was not created.
This is an execution-resource failure and is not evidence that either model can or cannot describe the selected structures.
payload.one_executable_step: After new explicit authorization, resubmit the unchanged hash-bound eight-structure GPU prediction request only when a runtime GPU-availability check shows the assigned GPU is not already occupied; do not submit VASP in the same action.
payload.submission_boundary: Job 1343 exhausted the one-job authorization. No automatic retry, VASP submission, model fine-tuning, path rerun, Dimer, TS, or barrier action is authorized.
done_when: The exact dual-model prediction set returns with matching structure and checkpoint hashes.
The returned predictions are reviewed and the same eight VASP inputs receive a separate bounded execution decision.
